WITH matched_qc AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL') as funding_source
  FROM scanqc sq
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
funding_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    funding_source,
    COUNT(*) as qc_count
  FROM matched_qc
  GROUP BY funding_source
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total,
    AVG(qc_count) as avg_count
  FROM funding_counts
)
SELECT 
  fc.funding_source,
  fc.qc_count,
  CAST(fc.qc_count AS REAL) / t.total as fraction_of_total,
  CAST(fc.qc_count AS REAL) / t.avg_count as divided_by_average
FROM funding_counts fc
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY fc.funding_source
